about: primary contests of 2014 in North Carolina, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local.py from pipeline/intake/klarner_state_legislative.py's cache.

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z
klarner.note: compiled by Klarner from official state returns (state election offices' websites when collected, and the earlier ICPSR editions); the origin of each race is not named, and whether a count is before or after a recount is not stated per race

fips.name: county FIPS codes: the county_name and county_fips columns of MEDSL's 2024 North Carolina precinct file

ncsbe.name: North Carolina State Board of Elections, precinct results by contest (results_pct files of the public download site's ENRS folder)
